paragraphs.source_en: The definitive or exact geographical extent of the Round Head paintings has not yet been firmly determined because it is problematic to assign some paintings to this style. Whereas on the Tassili Plateau the Round Heads are easily recognisable on its borders paintings often assume different styles or forms so that their attribution to the Round Heads is arguable1. Two main criteria in recognising the Round Head style used here are the painting technique and the motifs. The definition of style has to be necessarily flexible since authors, although creating paintings of a certain style, are likely to express themselves in a personal way and according to their own artistic skills. The Round Head paintings nevertheless present a great degree of uniformity everywhere, suggesting that their style and themes represented a generally respected norm.
